Description: Unique identifier assigned to each participant (original column subject, 1001-1111).
Unique identifier for a single trial (original column numinit). It is unique across the whole file and increases with presentation order within each participant; values are not contiguous.
Presentation order within the session (0-indexed). The order in which the participant saw this trial. Derived by sorting each participant's trials on trial_id.
Block the trial belongs to (original column block, 1-109). A block had 260 positions; sessions normally consisted of two blocks.

Position of the trial within its block (1-indexed; original column trial_num_block). Positions 1-10 of each block were practice trials and are not in the original data, so recorded values start at 11.
Lexicality of the stimulus: word or pseudoword (original column category, w/p).
The letter string presented to the participant (original column target).

Participant's response, word or nonword. Not recorded in the original data; derived from stimulus_type and accuracy. Empty for the one incorrect trial at the 2 s response deadline (participant 1006, trial_id 151696, rt 2000.01), which is probably a timeout.
Binary indicator of whether the participant's response was correct (1 = correct; original column correct).
Time taken by the participant to respond, in milliseconds, as in the original data.

Flag carried over unchanged from the original data; not documented by the authors. 1 on 1,029 trials, most of which are a second presentation of the same stimulus to the same participant (see README.md).
